[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1327308441324097681?label=discord&color=blue&logo=discord)](https://discord.gg/5UdcDa5xNC)
[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/ly-agility-enchantment?label=modrinth&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/ly-agility-enchantment)
[![许可证](https://img.shields.io/github/license/lullaby6/data-packs)](https://github.com/lullaby6/data-packs/blob/main/LICENSE)

## 📖 描述

`灵活` 是一种用于护腿的全新附魔，拥有两个等级。它能提升你的步行高度，让你更快速、高效地行走并穿过方块。

该附魔可通过附魔台、战利品箱或与村民交易获得。

## ⌨️ 指令

获取：

```mcfunction
/loot give @s loot agility_enchantment:<等级>
```

附魔：

```mcfunction
/enchant @s agility_enchantment:agility <等级>
```
